chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 322: The Hidden Dangers of Fame – Politics in the Brightmoon Painting
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning faces the deadly downside of fame as he becomes a top target in the Brightmoon Landscape Painting. Political scheming among Pure Yang True Immortals adds new tension to the Immortal Fortunes Assembly.
og_title: Desolate Era – The Hidden Dangers of Fame
og_description: Ji Ning is hunted by everyone after his name hits the "top 100" list. The Grand Xia Emperor worries about an ancient Buddhist Bodhisattva's schemes.
twitter_title: Desolate Era 322: Fame = Death Wish in the Brightmoon Painting
twitter_description: Ji Ning's kill list fame has made him public enemy #1. Can he survive the late-stage tournament by forcing his enemies to concede?

lore_anchors.definition: A true immortal whose soul is completely purified of yin energy, reaching a state of pure yang. In the Three Realms hierarchy, they are supreme beings with power to influence the fate of entire worlds.
A treasure world created by the Xia Emperor for the final stage of his Immortal Fortunes Assembly, serving as an isolated battlefield where Wanxiang Adepts fight for tokens to qualify.
The Grand Xia's primary intelligence and trading organization; they publish rankings and assessments of cultivators that can make or break a reputation.
The "life tokens" in this trial; giving yours up means instant elimination and teleportation out of the painting world.
Ji Ning's signature binding and strangulation spell, formed from interlocking lotus leaves of Taiyin True Water and Sunstar True Fire; recently upgraded to use first-grade elemental foundations.
Fundamental natural energies used as the core of a spell; their grade (1st to 9th) determines the spell's raw power and durability.
A classic Xianxia divine ability that allows a Fiendgod Body Refiner to grow extra limbs, dramatically increasing close-combat offense and defense.
